### Optical Capability or Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the optical physics feature or CAD functionality you would like to see.

### Academic Literature / Reference Standard
Please link public textbook or standard references (e.g. Born & Wolf *Principles of Optics*, Kingslake, Warren Smith, ISO 10110).
*Note: Under OpticsLab clean-room rules, proprietary commercial CAD macro files or decompiled schemas are strictly prohibited.*

### Proposed Interface / Workflow
Describe how users or solvers would interact with this feature (in UI, CLI, or engine commands).

### Additional Context
Any relevant diagrams, formulas, or motivation.
